query_text: Buy a return train ticket from Boston to New York for next Friday

action.query: Amtrak Boston to New York June 5 2026 train tickets
queries: Amtrak Boston to New York June 5 2026 train tickets

annotations.title: Boston to New York Train - Amtrak Tickets $22 | Wanderu
Fire near NY's Penn Station causes Amtrak train delays, cancellations in Connecticut

content.text:
I can’t purchase the ticket for you directly or enter payment details, but I can help you book it.

**“Next Friday” is Friday, June 5, 2026.** For Boston → New York, you’ll likely want **Amtrak** from **Boston South Station** or **Back Bay** to **NY Moynihan Train Hall at Penn Station**. This route has direct **Northeast Regional** and faster **Acela** options; recent listings show many daily trains, with prices varying heavily by time and fare class. ([wanderu.com](https://www.wanderu.com/en-us/train/us-ma/boston/us-ny/new-york/?utm_source=openai))

Before you book, you’ll need to choose:

1. **Return date/time** — same day, Sunday, or another date?
2. **Departure station in Boston** — South Station or Back Bay?
3. **Preferred time** — morning, afternoon, evening?
4. **Train type** — cheaper Northeast Regional or faster Acela?
5. **Passenger details/payment** — handled directly on Amtrak’s site/app.

To buy: go to **Amtrak**, search **Boston, MA → New York, NY**, select **Round Trip**, set outbound to **June 5, 2026**, choose your return date, then pick the trains and pay.

One note: there were recent Northeast Corridor disruptions near New York Penn Station reported on May 29, 2026, so check Amtrak’s live status/travel alerts before finalizing. ([ctinsider.com](https://www.ctinsider.com/news/article/amtrak-train-ct-cancellations-delays-penn-fire-22282249.php?utm_source=openai))
